items.text: kalayan gaya nyarita kontol maneh kitu, meunang ngaran Alain Kontolon.
items.q: 'Alain Kontolon' is meant as a rude pun on the actor Alain Delon. Would Sundanese readers get it? If not, what word could carry it?

items.text: Hujan mah moal turun ti taneuh ka langit.
items.q: Her son says he would die for her; Maman objects. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Leungeun kuring pondok, tepung jeung manéh jauh.
items.q: Amir tells the girl he loves why he holds back. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Bibi, mugia Alloh ngahampura dosana, sok nyarita dina waktu-waktu kieu: lamun kuring nyarita, létah kuring ngaduruk; lamun kuring teu nyarita, sungsum tulang kuring ngaduruk.
items.q: Maman hesitates before criticising her husband. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: – Ghasem sok kitu deui, nyarita taun nu alus dipikanyaho ti usum semina.
items.q: The family's New Year visits were cancelled; a brother jokes about it. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?
Maman quotes a lonely friend who has nothing to do all day. A Persian saying kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: – Sagala kalakuan manéhna téh matak maéhan batur, éta jelema.
items.q: Is it clear everything Farid did was self-destructive?
before: – Enya, kuring aya di dieu waktu éta kajadian.

Imut panungtungan Farid ngababakan payuneun panon kuring, tapi bau getih anu ngariung dina uteuk kuring ngusir deui gambaran éta. Sora Hooman muka jalan ti tengah-tengah imut jeung getih, terus asup ka ceuli kuring.

items.text: – Manéhna maksa ulah dihudangkeun. Manéh mah teu kungsi ngomong, naha manéh moal paéh lamun kamari gé teu muka sungut?
items.q: Is it clear the speaker means: you should have kept quiet yesterday too?

items.text: Sabaraha kali ogé kuring nyarita, ulah diteunggeul budak, manéhna nyarita, kuring shell-shock waktu perang, teu kuat ditahan.
items.q: He blames his violence on war trauma. Is 'shell-shock' clear to Sundanese readers?
before: – Urang mah ngan heureuy sina seuri, Nana-pesar-jan. Naha manéhna bakal indit? Upama enya indit, éta pisan nu dipenta ku kuring ka Alloh. Ku Alloh. Ku nyawa kuring sorangan. Hal nu kajadian ka Hashem jeung Abolfazl ogé salahna manéhna. Manéhna sok neunggeul maranéhna.
